name: Muhammad XI of Granada
role: Last Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada
contribution: The 22nd and last Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada in Iberia.
legacy: Eventually, in January 1492, Granada was surrendered, and the king spent some time on the lands which he was allowed to hold in Andalusia.

checks.lead: Abu Abdallah Muhammad XI (Arabic: أبو عبد الله محمد الحادي عشر, romanized: Abū ʿAbdi-llāh Muḥammad al-ḥādī ʿashar; c. 1460–1533), known in Europe as Boabdil, was the 22nd and last Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada in Iberia.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
